title: Novel meta-Selective Friedel–Crafts Acylation of Phenylsilsesquioxane
abstract: Abstract                The Friedel–Crafts acylation of octaphenylsilsesquioxane (T8Ph8) (1) with Cl2CHOCH3 or CH3COCl at low temperature followed by subsequent hydrolysis provided the octakis(m-acylphenyl)octasilsesquioxanes (T8(C6H4R-m)8); R = CHO (2a) and R = COCH3 (2b) in high yields. The remarkable meta-selectivity of 2a and 2b in more than 99:1 and 93:7 meta/para ratios was confirmed by 1H NMR and X-ray analyses, and further elucidated via theoretical calculations.
